description: This request for information focuses on the provision of the above-referenced Depot Activation capabilities for the F-15 EX’s current EX FLOW CONTROL VALVE. The repair and maintenance of the FLOW CONTROL VALVE requires not only the FLOW CONTROL VALVE itself but all associated parts/spares and the rights in technical data necessary to maintain and ensure the software used in the displays functions correctly to support verification of repairs at designated ALC.
